🚗 I Followed a Brand New Tesla Model Y Driving Itself — NO DRIVER — From the Production Line all the Way to the Shipping Yard!

Watch as this fully autonomous white Model Y rolls off the production line and drives itself completely hands-free across the entire Fremont Factory campus and into the shipping area. Zero human intervention from start to finish.

But that's not all — while I was there, I also caught Cybercab testing happening on the track! You’ll see the robotaxi in action during real-world development runs.

Drop a like if you’re excited for the future of autonomy! 🔥

Shot on  @Antigravity_HQ A1, purchase one here: Antigravity A1 - antigravity.tech/drone/antig…

🌍☀️ Elon Musk on the true scale of energy:

"The Earth only receives about half a billionth of the Sun’s energy.  

The Sun is 99.8% of all mass in the solar system… Earth is in the miscellaneous category.  

Earth is like a tiny dust mote in a vast darkness.  

The way to actually scale civilization is to scale power in space."

Mind officially blown.  

We’re not energy-limited — we’re location-limited. Time to build in space. 🚀🔋
